claim_text: Rep. Jamie Raskin, the top Judiciary Democrat, said anyone involved in Paramount's attempt to purchase Warner Bros. Discovery should be prepared to answer under oath, as a Paramount lawyer said the company was happy to cooperate with Democrats vowing a crackdown on the merger.
